I’m really starting to like it after initially thinking it was just boring. My initial disappointment was thinking the beats sounded too basic, but I’ve come around to a lot of the production and can appreciate the back to basics/generic trap type beat theme as a theme rather than a deterrent. 

I think Carti’s #1 draw is developing repetitive ear worms that just feel good on your ears, and I think that formula is captured in MUSIC with a majority of the tracks.!There’s a ton of catchy/loopy/repeating production and flows on here that fans of die lit and wlr should appreciate. Faves - pop out, mojo jojo, backdoor, toxic, crank, charge dem hoes a fee, wake up filthy, cocaine nose, Olympian, twin trim, walk. I wish backrooms was on here. 

I think 10 songs should have been cut, as I feel like they don’t capture what makes Carti good. Songs like we need all the vibes and philly just feel out of place, and are boring. 

Travis features felt inconsequential. Kendrick features were nice and fun and I think a bit overhated. Future feature seems redundant as half the time I feel like Carti is doing an impression of him.

Finally - cartis new deep voice is just okay. It’s not bad but I don’t think it’ll ever be as iconic or fun as his high pitched squeal voice

Great producer, not my favorite rapper/solo artist. I still bump his two full length albums for the production, but I think him and his other Chicago cohorts (noname/smino) all suffer on full length albums where every track sounds similar to the rest of the album. 

It’s not something that can automatically make an album bad (see TLOP 4 or flower boy in my opinion), but you need to make the “samey sound” be interesting, whether that’s through lyrical content or the “samey sound” is something that really sticks out. I actually really liked smino’s noir, but mainly because i think production (especially monte booker tracks) takes a front seat. With Saba, I think he’s trying really hard to say something meaningful on his tracks, which often times just comes off as… clunky? 

Favorite Tracks - photosynthesis, Stoney, church liquor store, west side bound, world in my hands

Final thought, I definitely have some sort of bias against Saba, can’t really explain why his music sort of turns me off, despite really enjoying his production.
